On vehicles equipped with a windscreen misting sensor, when the air conditioning is on and there is condensation, it does not work and the windscreen mists up.

The climate control system should intervene, forcing the recirculation flap into the dynamic air position, activating the compressor, controlling the distribution of air to the windscreen and activating the heated rear windscreen.
